duel.objective: Land a light attack on Ren.
duel.dialogue: REN: One clean hit. Then you can brag about it forever.

dodge.dialogue: REN: Your turn to move. Don't let me catch you standing still.

counter.objective: Land the final attack on Ren.
counter.dialogue: REN: There. You always wait too long for that one.

countdown.objective: The final shutdown is counting down.
countdown.dialogue: SYSTEM: Thank you for playing. The world will close shortly.

exit.objective: Press E to open the exit menu.
exit.dialogue: AMARA: Ren. I can feel the rain.

gate.objective: Follow the road to the city gate. Press E near the giant.
gate.dialogue: SYSTEM: Return route severed. Your body is waiting.

train.objective: Reach Ren at the platform. Press E near the train.
train.dialogue:
GIANT: My family is behind that door.
REN: Amara. There are lights on the old tracks.

ending.objective: Walk to the empty platform and press E.
ending.dialogue:
REN: Come on. Someone in here knows the way out.
The doors close before you can reach him.

complete.dialogue: AMARA: Ren, where are you going?
